messages:
anya: dropped a prototype for compact variant list + commit-jump quick search. main asks: 1) how do we handle focus when rollback modal opens (should it trap?), 2) microcopy for tiny allocation chips, 3) compressing version list for touch. figma: https://www.figma.com/file/abc (frame 7).

omar: quick thought — yes trap modal focus for rollback confirm. but we need an escape route for screen reader users: include a visible 'Cancel' and ensure ESC closes. Also add aria-describedby linking to rationale text so SR users know consequences.

TIA: copy nit: the allocation chip currently just shows "5%". users often read the chip out of context. suggest "5% (canary)" or prepend a faint label "Alloc: 5%" in compact mode. keeps length but improves clarity.

hugo: timeline compression: reduce each version row to 30px with an icon-only commit avatar and reveal full details on hover/focus. on touch devices, tapping expands. caution: current hit target is 24px which fails 44px min. bump padding to 44px and rely on hover to show extra info on desktop.

anya: good notes. regarding modal: do we want the rollback CTA to be primary or destructive-styled? UX wants primary for quick recovery but accessibility suggests red for destructive. thoughts?

omar: prefer destructive style (red) for rollback, but can be a strong-outline primary on the header and a red text/button for the destructive action. also ensure contrast ratios: current token red500 on dark header reads 3.7:1. need 4.5:1.

TIA: another microcopy idea: instead of "Rollback to v3", use "Rollback to v3 (safe)", no that's weird. maybe include short rationale: "Rollback to v3 — revert config+model" so users know what's reverted. keep it under 30 chars.

ux-bot: accessibility scan results: 
- Missing aria-describedby on rollback-modal (suggested ids: rollback-explain)
- Allocation chip text contrast fail in compact mode (computed 3.2:1)
- Interactive rows < 44px touch target (6 occurrences)
- Focus order on expanded commit detail inconsistent (2 sequences)

hugo: for commit-jump search: add fuzzy search that matches commit short ids and message prefix. put it at top of version list as a sticky mini search. hits should show keyboard shortcut (/) to open.

anya: action list:
- design: add cancel + aria-describedby in rollback modal + make focus trap explicit (anya + omar)
- writing: provide compact chip copy options: "Alloc: 5%", "5% (canary)", "5% • canary" (tia)
- eng: increase touch target to 44px, implement sticky commit-jump search with keyboard shortcut (hugo to sync)
- infra: validate color tokens for dark header and propose red token that meets 4.5:1

omar: can we get updated mocks by Tue morning? I'll coordinate dev slot for touch targets.

anya: yes, aiming for Monday EOD but Tue morning is ok. will post updated frames and call out new token usage. :white_check_mark:
